behavior.text: forever, if you see something red in front of you, honk and back up

claude.title: Red Alert Honk
summary: Forever: if something red is ahead, honk and back up
claude.notes: It looks 10 studs ahead and backs up 5 studs when it sees something red, like the Red House. It doesn't drive forward by itself, so you'll need to drive it toward something red.

behavior.text: when I press f, make everything float for 5 seconds and then drop a bunch of rainbow bricks

claude.title: Float Then Rainbow Rain
summary: When you press f: everything floats for 5 seconds
Then gravity comes back and rainbow bricks fall from the sky
claude.notes: Gravity goes back to normal before the bricks drop so they actually fall. Select the World before pressing f.
